rationale: Does per-allocation, per-project, per-user job accounting on national HPC grants (the XSEDE/ACCESS model AI compute-grant programs copy), giving a funder the job-level attribution evidence needed to audit what a researcher's awarded compute allocation was actually spent on -- attests utilization, not stated intent, but is the strongest available mechanism-level match.

Implements the verifier side of TDX/SGX/SEV-SNP remote attestation and gates secret release on the resulting evidence -- exactly the 'use a TEE to attest to what hardware is running this' capability RQ50 asks about.

Generates and verifies attestation reports binding platform/chip identity and running code, extended into attested TLS channels -- a directly independent (non-vendor) implementation of RQ50's chip-identity-attestation question.

Produces and checks signed golden firmware measurements without which a chip's SEV-SNP attestation report can't actually be adjudicated -- supplies the reference-value half of 'robustly attest' that a bare attestation report alone doesn't provide.
